description: Return the prices and the complete published pricing terms for QConsul's two bookable services: Standard Hourly at $425/hour and the Executive 1:1 Subscription at $399/month. Read-only and idempotent; the terms are returned verbatim from qconsultai.com, structured to mirror the Services page. Usage: call this when a customer asks what a session costs or what the cancellation, reschedule, and refund rules are, before booking. Returns prices and terms only; it books nothing and shows no availability. For the service catalog and ids, use list_services; for open times, use check_availability.
name: get_pricing_and_terms

cancellationAndRescheduling.description: Session cancellation and rescheduling terms, verbatim published text.

precedence.description: Statement of which terms take precedence, verbatim published text.

rateNote.description: Standard rate statement, verbatim published text.

service.description: Name of the hourly service the rate applies to.

sessionTotal.description: Total charged for one 1-hour session, e.g. $425.00.

standardRateTerms.description: Standard rate terms, verbatim published text.

description.description: Executive 1:1 Subscription description, verbatim published text.

termsEffectiveDate.description: Effective date of the terms, ISO 8601 date.

termsGroups.description: Complete pricing terms grouped as on the Services page, verbatim published text.

termsUrl.description: URL of the published terms on qconsultai.com.

termsVersion.description: Version of the published Pricing Details and Terms.

validThrough.description: Date the published prices are valid through.
